verdict.rationale: Entra ID ships automations through Lifecycle Workflows and app provisioning, so this axis applies. However, nothing in the evidence documents versioning, review/approval of changes, or rollback of those workflows. Mentions of workflows running automatically, and of routing activity logs for retention, are adjacent features and do not show version control or rollback of automations.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can version, review, and roll back my automations
